title: Signing Bonus Clawback Analyzer
description: Models the true net cost of a signing bonus clawback. Inputs: gross bonus, clawback period and structure (full/pro-rated), federal marginal rate, state rate, FICA, repayment year. Outputs: after-tax received, four repayment scenarios (same-year wash, IRC §1341 credit, itemized deduction, worst-case), pro-rated obligation timeline. Zero external data. AP2 v2.0: signing_bonus_record.
data_vintage: IRS Pub. 525; IRC §1341; IRS supplemental wage rate 22% — no time-sensitive data embedded
regulatory_citations: IRS Publication 525 — Taxable and Nontaxable Income
IRC §1341 — Computation of Tax Where Taxpayer Restores Substantial Amount
IRS Topic No. 419 — Gambling Income (claim of right doctrine cross-reference)

mcp_tool_definition.name: analyze_signing_bonus_clawback
mcp_tool_definition.description: Given gross signing bonus, clawback period, tax rates, and repayment year, returns after-tax amount received, gross repayment obligation, IRC §1341 tax recovery, and net true cost across four scenarios. Deterministic, zero external data.
